name: 90230 · Culver City, CA
findings: ZIP 90230 (Culver City) has 240 nonprofit organizations. 89 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90230 (Culver City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90230 (Culver City) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
